Nina (Billing): FYI Stripe flagged FluxCo (acct_89234) for duplicate refunds and temporarily put payouts on hold. Stripe event: evt_1JkXyZ. Dashboard link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/payments/pm_89... Should we leave the hold?
Liam: Can you paste the webhook payload or a quick screenshot of the dashboard?
Maya (Risk): On it. Need the refund webhooks + invoice/batch id to triage velocity.
Nina (Billing): Paste of refund event payload below:
```
{
  "id": "evt_1JkXyZ",
  "type": "charge.refund.updated",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "re_1LAa1B",
      "amount": 100000,
      "currency": "usd",
      "charge": "ch_1AaBbC",
      "metadata": {"invoice_batch": "inv_batch_20260320-47", "merchant_reason": "merchant_initiated_duplicate"}
    }
  }
}
```
fraud-bot: Alert: refund velocity threshold exceeded — 5 refunds in 2h for acct_89234. Risk score: 84%. Recommend hold. :warning:
Sam (FinOps): Is this our automated reconciliation kicking duplicate refunds, or did the merchant issue them twice? We need to know before we reverse anything.
Tilly (Ops): I see three refunds with the same original_payment_intent (pi_12345). Two refunds are identical amounts ($1,000.00). That's suspicious. Holding payout now.
Maya (Risk): Action items: 1) Collect merchant comms/invoice for inv_batch_20260320-47; 2) Request full Stripe logs (webhooks + dashboard audit); 3) Prepare dispute response template if chargeback. I can draft.
Liam: CC @legal (for timelines) — if this becomes a chargeback we need the audit trail.
Nina (Billing): Notified account rep (samuel@fluxco.com). @Sam (FinOps) can you provisionally approve reversal if we confirm accidental duplicate? :eyes:
Sam (FinOps): I approve provisional reversal up to $3,000 pending evidence. DM me the batch file.
Tilly (Ops): Payout blocked and portal note added: "Under review — duplicate refund flag (FluxCo)". I'll also tag the ledger entry: ledger_tx_8891.
fraud-bot: Automated follow-up scheduled in 2h to re-evaluate after logs are in.
Maya (Risk): Thanks — I'll post final disposition by EOD. If merchant confirms duplicate refund, we process reversal and clear hold. If they dispute, we escalate to disputes/legal.
Liam: Quick checklist for whoever owns evidence: transaction ids, refund ids, original receipts, merchant request email, and any gateway logs. Post here when uploaded. :thumbsup:
Nina (Billing): Uploading merchant email thread and batch CSV to /shared/finance/fluxco/1914302468.
Sam (FinOps): Got it. I'll coordinate reversal if confirmed.
Tilly (Ops): Keeping payout on hold until confirmation or legal says otherwise.
Maya (Risk): I'll close loop here after I review logs (ETA 4 hours).
Nina (Billing): Thanks all — will update when merchant replies.
